question: What is the compound interest on a sum of Rs. 12,500 at 15% p.a. in 2 years, if the interest is compounded 8-monthly?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Time = 2 years = 24 months = 3 cycles of 8 months.

Rate per 8 months = 15% × (8 ÷ 12) = 10%.

Effective compound interest rate for 10% over 3 cycles = 33.1%.

CI = 33.1% of ₹12,500 = (33.1 ÷ 100) × 12500

CI = 331 × 12.5 = ₹4137.50

**∴ The correct answer is ₹4137.50.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹12,500

Rate of interest (R) = 15% p.a.

Time (T) = 2 years

Compounding frequency = 8-monthly
